item.title: Fan Dies After Falling From Balcony During Goose Concert at Madison Square Garden
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our breaking news update. We have some sad news to share with you tonight. A tragic incident occurred at Madison Square Garden in New York City on Saturday, during a concert by the rock band Goose."
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "A 51-year-old man, who was attending the sold-out show with his wife, fell from an upper-level seating area and died. According to the NYPD, officers found the man unconscious and unresponsive at approximately 9:51 p.m. He was rushed to Bellevue Hospital, where he was pronounced dead."
[Pause for a moment]
Host: "The incident is still under investigation, and authorities haven't released any additional details about the fall. The band, Goose, took to social media to express their condolences, saying they were 'deeply saddened and heartbroken' by the tragedy."
[Soft music continues]
Host: "This incident is unfortunately not the first of its kind in the New York area. In 2021, a fan died after falling from a stadium balcony during a Dead & Company concert at Citi Field. Our thoughts are with the family and loved ones of the victim."
[Outro music starts]
Host: "That's all for now. We'll continue to follow this story and provide updates as more information becomes available. Thank you for listening."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
